text: In 1953, during the First Indochinese War, the orphaned country girl Linh [takes a job as housemaid|trigger|saying yes to an offer] on [a haunted French rubber plantation|threat|evil places]. There she falls in love with the French landowner, Captain Sebastien Laurent, and awakens [the vengeful ghost of his dead wife, Camille|origin|the wronged dead return], who is out for blood.
